SELECT
        id,
        material_no,
        material_name,
        spec,
        unit,
        stock_qty as current_stock,
        COALESCE(min_stock, 0) as min_stock,
        COALESCE(max_stock, 0) as max_stock,
        unit_price,
        ROUND(stock_qty * unit_price, 2) as stock_value,
        CASE
          WHEN stock_qty <= 0 THEN 'thiếuhàng'
          WHEN stock_qty <= min_stock THEN 'tồn khokhông đủ'
          WHEN stock_qty >= max_stock THEN 'tồn khoquacao'
          ELSE 'bình thường'
        END as stock_status,
        CASE
          WHEN stock_qty <= 0 THEN 3
          WHEN stock_qty <= min_stock THEN 2
          WHEN stock_qty >= max_stock THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END as warning_level
      FROM inv_material
      WHERE deleted = 0
      ORDER BY warning_level DESC, stock_value DESC
Common.k_chudez:
SELECT
        b.id as batch_id,
        b.batch_no,
        b.quantity,
        b.available_qty,
        COALESCE(b.locked_qty, 0) as locked_qty,
        b.inbound_date,
        b.expire_date,
        b.opened_at,
        b.production_date,
        COALESCE(b.supplier_name, '') as supplier_name,
        COALESCE(b.source_inbound_no, '') as source_inbound_no,
        CASE
          WHEN b.expire_date IS NOT NULL AND b.expire_date <= CURDATE() THEN 'đãhết hạn'
          WHEN b.expire_date IS NOT NULL AND b.expire_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN '30ngàytronghết hạn'
          WHEN b.opened_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'đãmở bao bì'
          ELSE 'bình thường'
        END as batch_status,
        DATEDIFF(b.expire_date, CURDATE()) as days_until_expiry
      FROM inv_inventory_batch b
      WHERE b.material_id = ? AND b.deleted = 0
      ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN b.opened_at IS NOT NULL THEN b.opened_at ELSE b.inbound_date END ASC,
        b.expire_date ASC,
        b.inbound_date ASC,
        b.id ASC

        COALESCE(qr.material_name, '') AS materialName

      AND qr.deleted = 0
      ORDER BY qr.create_time ASC
